title: Identify $$\frac{Slope}{y}-intercept$$
text: What is given that is fixed? What can change based on another variable? The fixed cost of $25,000 is fixed and $$\$0.25$$ per doughnut can change our cost based on the amount of doughnuts produced.

title: Writing a Linear Model
